categories.main_business_segments: The company's primary business is the research and development, production, and sales of helicopter integrated display and control equipment, along with related professional technical services. The company is a leading integrated system integrator and technical solution provider in China's military helicopter display and control equipment field. Main products include airborne multifunction display and control equipment and embedded computer modules.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company specializes in video processing technology and comprehensive joint test technology. It has established a complete scientific research and production system with self-owned intellectual property core technologies. The company controls key links including system integration, R&D design, engineering procurement, product assembly, and quality control, while outsourcing non-core production processes such as welding and testing to maintain core technology security.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The company's main customers are subsidiaries of China Aviation Industry Corporation and other state-owned military enterprises, with end users being the military. The company serves the military helicopter market, including transport helicopters, general-purpose helicopters, and other helicopter types. Customer concentration is high, with the top five customers accounting for 97.67% of annual sales.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in mainland China. Its registered address is in Beijing's Shunyi District, with main office in Xi'an's Chang'an District. The company's business is entirely domestic, with 100% of revenue from China. The company has a subsidiary, Boke Tiancheng (Xi'an) Electronic Technology Co., Ltd., also located in Xi'an.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream of the aerospace supply chain. It functions as a system integrator and component supplier, receiving orders from primary contractors (subsidiaries of major state-owned aerospace enterprises) who then integrate the company's products into complete systems for delivery to the military end-users.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company's strategic priorities include: (1) consolidating and enhancing market position in airborne multifunction display equipment; (2) advancing military airborne integrated visual scene and navigation products; (3) expanding flight mission planning products; (4) developing high-reliability specialized electronic modules. The company maintains continuous R&D investment with 26.69% of 2024 revenue allocated to R&D, focusing on next-generation aviation electronic systems.
categories.revenue_model: The company generates revenue primarily through direct sales of military products to primary contractors. Revenue is recognized when customers obtain control of products, typically upon delivery and customer acceptance. The company also provides technical services and maintenance. Products are sold on credit terms typical in military procurement, with payment following delivery and acceptance verification.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company holds a dominant market position as the primary supplier of military helicopter display and control equipment in China, controlling the majority market share. The company is the sole supplier for two helicopter series and a dual-source supplier for another series. The high barriers to entry in military aerospace electronics, combined with the company's 20+ years of experience and established relationships, provide significant competitive advantages.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: The company is a mid-sized aerospace equipment manufacturer. 2024 revenue was 180.02 million yuan (up 320.16% from negative 81.77 million in 2023, which was impacted by price adjustments). Net profit was 26.74 million yuan (up 115.97% from negative 167.41 million in 2023). Total assets were 1.46 billion yuan. The company has recovered from 2023 challenges and returned to profitability with strong growth in 2024.
